seasonalNotes: Hot summers (Mar–Jun, 40°C+). Monsoon Jul–Sep across most of India. Pleasant winters Oct–Feb (15–25°C). Heavy traffic in metros. Festival seasons: Diwali (Oct/Nov), Holi (Mar).

personas.name: Bengaluru Work Day
personas.tagline: ORR traffic, standup calls, and filter coffee
personas.description: Tech worker commuting along ORR from Indiranagar to Bellandur. Standup call, team lunch, Reliance Fresh stop, and chai at the corner stall.

stops.title: Fill water bottle + laptop bag
stops.description: Bangalore water is unpredictable. Carry your own.

stops.title: Darshini breakfast — idli vada
stops.description: Eat before getting stuck in ORR traffic.

stops.title: 10 AM standup — prep JIRA board
stops.description: Sprint review. Have your ticket status ready.

stops.title: Reliance Fresh — rice, dal, onions
stops.description: Essentials. Check JioMart prices while you're at it.

stops.title: Filter coffee at corner stall
stops.description: ₹20 for the best filter kaapi in the area.

personas.name: Mumbai Local & Meetings
personas.tagline: Western line, meetings, and street food
personas.description: Commutes via Mumbai local from Andheri to Churchgate. Client meetings, lunch at Swati Snacks, and Linking Road shopping on the way home.

stops.title: Check fast train timing
stops.description: Andheri to Churchgate fast: 45 min. Slow: 1 hr 15 min.

stops.title: Client meeting — carry hard copies
stops.description: Print 5 copies of the proposal. Client is old school.

stops.title: Lunch at Swati Snacks
stops.description: Panki, dahi puri, sev usal. Get there before 1 PM.

stops.title: Linking Road — birthday gift
stops.description: Find something for Priya's birthday. Budget ₹1500.

personas.name: Delhi Family Outing
personas.tagline: Temples, Chandni Chowk, and India Gate
personas.description: A family Sunday in Delhi: morning puja at Akshardham, Chandni Chowk paranthas, India Gate picnic, and Sarojini Nagar shopping.

stops.title: Morning darshan at Akshardham
stops.description: Open at 9:30 AM. No phones/cameras allowed inside.

stops.title: Paranthas at Paranthe Wali Gali
stops.description: Aloo, gobi, rabri parantha. Eat at the original shop.

stops.title: India Gate — evening walk
stops.description: Ice cream from the vendor. Sit on the lawns.

stops.title: Sarojini Nagar — kids' clothes
stops.description: Bargain hard. Start at half the asking price.

personas.name: Chennai Weekend
personas.description: A weekend in Chennai: morning jog at Marina Beach, Kapaleeshwarar Temple, biryani at Buhari's, and a walk in T. Nagar for silk sarees.

stops.title: Morning walk at Marina Beach
stops.description: Go before 7 AM. Sun gets brutal by 9.

stops.title: Idli at Murugan Idli Shop
stops.description: Soft idli + 3 chutneys. ₹60 for a plate.

stops.title: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
stops.description: Morning pooja. Remove footwear at the entrance.

stops.title: Biryani at Buhari's
stops.description: Chicken biryani + raita. Go before 12:30 or wait 45 min.

stops.title: Silk saree shopping — T. Nagar
stops.description: Nalli Silks or Pothys. Kanjivaram for mom's birthday.
